title: Stop the select route from destroying unrelated file descriptors
body:
# Stop the select route from destroying unrelated file descriptors

## Note
**This PR is a preliminary fix for 5.10 series kernel support.**

## Problem

`SelectStackRoute` builds its pselect fd_sets out of the waiter stamp, so the payload words *are* the bit
pattern: `open_selected_fds()` dup2s one of the route's own descriptors over every fd <
`PSELECT_ROUTE_NFDS` (320) whose bit happens to be set, and `destroy()` closed that quasi-random set. Only
stdio had a backup. Any
long-lived descriptor in that range — app fds, and the W2 victim's protocol pipes — was silently replaced
for the length of the dance and closed afterwards.

Observed while porting to a 5.10 kernel: the victim's command pipe was replaced at `prepare()`, the rooted
child read EOF, took its post-loop `getuid() != 0` guard and exited about one dance before the cred write
landed. `verify_w2_stage()` then hit EPIPE on every attempt and returned 0 *without printing anything*, so
W2 retried forever against an empty log. Every write landed; the chain never completed.

## Change

One commit, `fix(route): stop the select route from destroying unrelated file descriptors`.

**Snapshot and restore.** Every slot the dup2 pass rebinds is copied first — the descriptor plus its
`FD_CLOEXEC` state — and put back once the pselect returns, next to `restore_standard_io`; `destroy()`
restores instead of closing. A slot that was already closed is closed again; a live slot whose copy failed
is told apart from a closed one by reading `F_GETFD` first, and reported with its errno instead of passing
as closed.

**The forced exception slot.** It is installed after the bit scan, so the scan never snapshotted it:
whenever the stamp left its bit clear, that slot was rebound with no backup — the one descriptor in the
range the pass could still destroy for good, and a live app descriptor on any device holding that many fds
open. It now joins the scan.

**The victim's parent-held pipe ends** move above the range with `F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC`, and a failed move
fails the spawn: `fork()` needs no descriptor, so a child would otherwise run with an endpoint the route
can clobber.

**`verify_w2_stage()`** no longer returns 0 silently: both early returns print `errno`, which separates a
dead child (EPIPE, 0-byte reply) from a live one that is not consuming (full pipe, EAGAIN).

**Host coverage.** The snapshot lives outside the `__ANDROID__` guard — `destroy()` is host-compiled and
calls the restore — and it reports through its return value rather than printing, so the host test drives
the round trip: an open slot, a closed slot, `FD_CLOEXEC` on both sides, and the forced slot with its bit
left clear.

Three details worth knowing while reviewing:

- Backups are placed at `PSELECT_ROUTE_NFDS + 64`, above the range the pass walks — a copy inside the range
  could be poisoned by a later iteration of the same loop.
- `dup2` clears `FD_CLOEXEC` on its target, so the flag is read before the dup2 and re-applied after;
  otherwise a close-on-exec descriptor would come back without it.
- The restore zeroes its count, so `destroy()`'s call is a no-op when the per-attempt restore already ran.
  The consumer-stuck path deliberately keeps the installed descriptors, matching
  `retain_for_process_lifetime()`.

## Testing

Device: Redmi K50 Ultra (`diting`, SM8475), `5.10.236-android12-9-00003-gfb24cf99ad97-ab14313284`,
`select_stack` route, on both ROM builds that share that kernel (CN and Xiaomi.eu). Before: the chain
stopped at W2 on every run, silently. After: W1 → W2 (`child is root!`) → W3 → root script at `uid=0` →
KernelSU late-load, across a run series on the patched and on the stock kernel.

Re-run against this commit as a regression gate, because the fixes changed the fd path after that series:
three consecutive runs, every stage on attempt 1, `exploit complete` at T+31.5 s / 30.5 s / 35.2 s, root
script at `uid=0`, `native exited code=0`, SELinux restored to enforcing. No oops or panic in the kernel
log, and none of the new diagnostics fired — this device holds ~149 fds, far below the copy range, so the
uncopied-slot branch is not reachable on it as measured.

**Not tested: 6.6 / 6.12**.

title: Add verified Sharp AQUOS R8 SH-R80 5.15.178 profile
body:
## Target

Sharp AQUOS R8 SH-R80 (`FaYuiry`), build `SC525 / 04.00.00`.

Kernel:
`5.15.178-android13-8-00025-g7feb0b0b7cd8-ab14134651`

Google GKI provenance:
- Android common commit `7feb0b0b7cd82204ae4d1515e8a3cc3fc9f03529`
- Android CI build `14134651`
- `kernel_aarch64`

## Physical-device validation

The profile has completed **two successful direct/base-mode exploit runs** on the physical SH-R80 using fixed CPU pair **3,4**.

Observed successful stages included:
- W2 credential escalation to UID 0
- W3 seccomp bypass
- clean multicast route completion
- official KernelSU Android13-5.15 late-load handoff on the later run

`recommend_shizuku = 0` because direct mode was the successful/reliable path on this target. An earlier Shizuku/UserService run disconnected after W1.

## Extraction note

The extractor's embedded-symbol recovery initially mapped `remove_waiter` incorrectly and produced a false fixed-kernel result. Supplying the matching Google CI `System.map` resolved `remove_waiter` at `0x176d6e0` relative to `_text`; the extractor then reported the CVE-2026-43499 primitive present and selected `multicast_waiter`.

This PR only adds the verified profile + index entry; it intentionally does not guess at an extractor fix.

Device-specific notes and reproducibility guard live at: https://github.com/stupidgiraffe/aquos-r8-ghostlock

title: feat(anti-vrko): 接入完整反 vr.ko 流程 + 恢复 1.3 载荷功能 + 调整执行顺序（仅作建议，未做实际验证）
body:
# 完整适配反 vr.ko 逻辑 + 恢复 1.3 载荷功能 + 调整执行顺序

## ⚠️ 免责声明（请先读这一段）

**本 PR 仅作建议，未做实际验证。**

- 已完成的是**静态适配**与**编译验证**（aarch64 交叉编译通过、符号与字符串核对、APK 打包通过）。
- **未完成**真机运行验证：`neutralize_vr_probes` 的 `ok=1`、vr.ko 探针槽位定位、逐任务 tag 清除的实际效果，
  均**没有**在本机跑通确认。
- 因此本 PR 的所有改动都应视为**待验证的提案**，合并前请自行在目标设备上完整验证。
- 尤其：CFI 阶段涉及改写 `&ashmem_misc.fops` 与 `sys_exit` tracepoint 的 funcs 数组，
  属高危内核数据写；一旦地址推导有偏差，可能造成设备无法启动。**不要未经真机验证就分发。**

---

## 本 PR 做了什么

### 1. 接入参考仓库的完整反 vr.ko 流程

把 [CVE-2026-43499-Neo11Plus](https://github.com/boxiaolanya2008/CVE-2026-43499-Neo11Plus) 的反
vr.ko 两层机制完整接进本工程：

| 层 | 参考仓库位置 | 本工程落点 |
|---|---|---|
| 常驻内核读写（configfs fops 伪造 + pipe 物理读写） | `exploit/src/*` | `src/core/session/backend/cfi_stage.cpp` |
| 逐任务去 tag（`thread_info.flags` bit 0x400 + `task+0x06` / `task+0x2c`） | `root.c: patch_task_vr_tag` | `w2b` 阶段 |
| 探针外科手术式中和（读 `probestub`，按模块内 delta 定位 `sys_exit` 槽位，只改那一个槽） | `root.c: neutralize_vr` | `cfi_stage.cpp: neutralize_vr_probes` |

新增文件：
- `src/core/session/backend/cfi_layout.hpp`
- `src/core/session/backend/cfi_stage.hpp`
- `src/core/session/backend/cfi_stage.cpp`
- `src/core/tests/cfi_stage_test.cpp`

### 2. 恢复被 overlay 覆盖掉的 1.3 原载荷功能

`cve_2026_43499_backend.cpp` 在接入 overlay 时被整体替换（45 KB → 30 KB），
导致下列功能丢失，本 PR 全部补回：

- `bootimg::detect_device_brand_runtime`（品牌检测：属性优先，boot 字节回落）
- `bootimg::load_boot_image`（boot / vendor_boot / kcore 三路加载）
- `bootimg::probe_vrko_from_vendor_boot`（运行时解析 vr.ko 的 tag A/B 偏移）
- `bootimg::recover_sys_exit_tp_funcs`（profile 缺失时从内核内嵌 kallsyms/BTF 恢复）

**一处刻意的取舍**：把 `sys_exit.funcs` 指针整体清零的老式粗粒度写，用编译期开关
`GHOSTLOCK_LEGACY_SYSEXIT_KILLSWITCH` 默认**关闭**。原因是它与第 1 项的细粒度中和**硬冲突**：
`neutralize_vr_probes` 必须读 `sys_exit_tp.funcs[]` 才能定位 vr.ko 的模块内探针槽，
若先被整体清零，CFI 扫描会落空。解析/恢复逻辑全部保留并启用，只门住那一笔冲突的内核写。

### 3. 调整执行顺序：反 vr.ko 移到 KSU 移交之后

原顺序（会软重启）：

```
Backend(W1→W2→W3) → 【CFI + vr.ko 中和】 → Frontend handoff（ksud late-load 拿 root）
```

改后：

```
Backend(W1→W2→W3) → Frontend handoff（拿 root） → 【CFI + vr.ko 中和】
```

理由：CFI 阶段会替换 `&ashmem_misc.fops` 并改写 `sys_exit` 探针数组，
在 framework 尚未稳定、KernelSU 尚未接管时做这些，正是把设备带进软重启的时序。

改动位置：
- `src/core/session/backend/cve_2026_43499_backend.cpp`：移除 `run_cfi_stage<M>` 调用（留注释说明去向）
- `src/core/route/pipeline.hpp`：在 `Frontend::run()` 之后派发
  `session::backend::run_cfi_stage<Middleware>(exploit_session)`
- 顺带修正：KernelSU 本来就已 root 时（Backend 返 `Done`），现在也会执行反 vr.ko，
  不再直接 `DiagnosticStop` 返回

---

## Termux / aarch64 构建适配（3 处必须改）

overlay 的 `Makefile` 是按桌面 NDK 写的，在 Termux aarch64 上需要：

| 问题 | 修法 |
|---|---|
| 去掉了 Termux 回落，`NDK_ROOT` 为空 → 编译器路径变成 `/toolchains/...` | 提供 `NDK_ROOT` 指向一个假 NDK 目录；`aarch64-linux-android35-clang{,++}` 必须是**转发脚本**（不能做符号链接：Termux 包装器按自身目录找 `clang++`） |
| 硬编码 `-static-libstdc++`，Termux clang 会翻成 `-lc++_shared` → 链接失败 | 命令行覆盖 `LDFLAGS="-fPIE -pie -pthread -flto"` |
| `CXX_SRCS` 完全没列 `core/bootimg/*` → `detect_device_brand_runtime` 未定义 | 把 5 个 bootimg 源补进 `CXX_SRCS` |

---

## 编译验证结果（非真机运行验证）

- aarch64 交叉编译：**通过**，`build/native/ghostlock` = 259,768 B
- APK 打包：**BUILD SUCCESSFUL**，APK 内 `libghostlock.so` 与源码构建产物
  sha256 逐字节一致（`f912bc3f27096891`）
- 二进制标志串核对：`vr neutralize` ×12、`neutralized` ×2、`ghostlock_guard` ×5、
  `vendor_boot` ×16、`recovered tag_A` ×1

## 合并前建议补充的验证

1. 真机跑一次，确认出现：
   ```
   VR: recovered tag_A=0x.. tag_B=0x2c from ...
   vr neutralized: sys_exit probe slot=... func ...->... probestub=... ok=1
   ```
2. 确认 `dmesg` 不再出现 `scheduling while atomic`
3. 确认软重启后 `vr` 无法加载、`su` / KernelSU 不再被杀
4. `cmp_disasm` 对比攻击路径地址未漂移

title: feat(vrko): vivo vr.ko 中和 + 运行时 boot 镜像提取 + 构建修复（含真机证据）
body:
## 这个 PR 做什么

蓝厂（vivo/iQOO）`vr.ko` 反 root 检测的中和，加上让这份树能在**普通 x86_64 主机**上构建成功。

### 1. vr.ko 中和（攻击路径）

- **全局熔断**：把 `__tracepoint_sys_exit->funcs` 写 NULL —— `__DO_TRACE` 的外层守卫是
  `if (it_func_ptr)`，因此所有 `sys_exit` 探针（含 vr.ko 的 kill 路径）对**全系统所有任务**变成空操作，
  不需要知道任何探针地址；数据写入、幂等、与 KCFI 无关。
- **按任务清标记**：W2 校验前清 `thread_info.flags` 字与 tag B（两写都带重试与 settle）。
- 新增 run-state 步骤 `vr1`，Kotlin `RunStateCodec.Steps` 同步。
- profile 新字段 `offset.sys_exit_tp_funcs`：**可选**，只在有值时写出，因此**既有 profile 的 wire 字节一个都不变**。
- 写入守卫：vr1 的全局写与各阶段写都要求目标在 direct map 内且 8 字节对齐，否则拒绝并说明原因。

### 2. 运行时从 boot 镜像提取（`src/core/bootimg/`）

boot header v2/v3/v4 → kallsyms 令牌表 → 内嵌 BTF → LZ4-legacy → cpio newc → vendor_boot 里的 `vr.ko` 探针（tag A/B）。
两条用途：profile 没有 `sys_exit_tp_funcs` 时兜底；以及**任何写入之前**用暂存的 `uefi.img` 交叉校验物理基址
（基址错了会让每个写地址偏移 —— 拒绝运行而不是硬写）。

### 3. 提取器与 App

- `tools/extract_rs`：输出 `sys_exit_tp_funcs`（符号 + BTF 成员**都解析出来才写**）；新增
  `--dump-partition`，本地完整包也能取出 `vendor_boot.img` 供运行时探针使用。
- App：vendor_boot 导入流程（校验 magic 与体积，按运行时读取的名字暂存）；「附加镜像」可附加
  xbl_config / uefi / vendor_boot；两个 native 文件（`libghostlock.so`、`libextract.so`）的生成步骤写进 `构建说明.md`。

### 4. 构建修复（来自真实主机构建）

| 文件 | 修复 |
|---|---|
| `src/core/kernel/constants.hpp` | 先 `#undef PAGE_SIZE / PAGE_SHIFT` 再包含 `offset.h`（宿主/NDK 头同名宏冲突） |
| `gradle.properties` | JDK 安装路径 + 抑制 compileSdk 37.2 的 unsupported 报错（**路径是构建机相关**，换机器需改） |
| `GhostlockViewModel.kt` | `DocumentRequest` 补回 `PayloadImage`（三处引用，缺它编译失败） |

### 5. 真机证据

`docs/evidence/vrko-v8-real-device.md` 与同目录截图：iQOO Neo10 Pro+（vivo PD2463、
`6.6.89-android15-8-g1f71897ac249-abogki467805059-4k`）上 KernelSU 管理器显示
**工作中 [越狱模式]（32601-2, LKM）**，日志尾部 `late-load` / `KernelSU ready` / `result: exploit completed`。

### 6. 未验证与已知限制（请按此评估）

- **没有逐项门禁记录**：没有 `tools/cmp_disasm.py` 对比、冷机、固定 CPU 对、KernelSU 未加载的干净启动，
  因此本次**不能**据此标 supported。
- **本修订之后的改动没有真机检验**，本 PR 不含它们。
- 曾在**另一份未发布构建**上观察到 W2 重试 15 次全败；那次日志没有留存，所以既未定位、也不声称已修。
- 根目录的 `PR.md` / `PR_CHECKLIST.sh` / `IMPLEMENTATION_COMPLETE.patch` / `EXTRACT_TRACEPOINT_CONSTANTS.md`
  是工作笔记，如不需要可在合并前删掉。

关联：该方向源自 #241（同作者，方案已并入本 PR 的实现方式）。

title: feat(vrko): 添加稳定性强化 v2 - 全局 sys_exit 探针熔断 + 重试循环
body:
## 📝 变更摘要

本 PR 为 vivo vr.ko 反 Root 检测提供**稳定性强化 v2**方案，相比之前的 PR #241 设计有重大改进：

### 核心改进

1. **全局熔断机制**（`vr1` 步骤）：NULL 掉 `sys_exit_tp_funcs` 指针而非重定向到 probestub
   - `__DO_TRACE` 已有 `if (it_func_ptr)` 守卫，NULL 指针使所有 sys_exit 探针变为 no-op
   - 完全绕过 tracepoint 结构体布局假设（CONFIG_HAVE_STATIC_CALL 影响 funcs 偏移达 0x28 字节）
   - 纯数据写入，幂等，KCFI 兼容
   - 仅需 profile 提供 `sys_exit_tp_funcs` 偏移，运行时单次写直到重启

2. **增强重试循环**（`w2b` 步骤）：
   - flags+tagA 清除增加重试循环（与 W2 相同节奏）
   - tagB 清除增加重试循环（64 位对齐）
   - 避免因单次 race 丢失导致整个 chain round 浪费

3. **探测逻辑优化**：
   - `/proc/modules` 探测移到 `vr1` 步骤，每进程只运行一次
   - 结果共享给 `w2b` 的 per-task tag clear

### 新增设备 Profile

- **PD2463** (iQOO Neo10 Pro+): `6.6.89-android15-8-g1f71897ac249-abogki467805059-4k`
  - `sys_exit_tp_funcs = 36315752` (0xffffffc0822a2268)
  - 经 BTF + 静态数据交叉验证

- **iQOO15**: `6.12.58-android16-6-g0a092cc0037a-abogki521987229-4k`
  - `sys_exit_tp_funcs = 40735656` (0xffffffc0826d93a8)
  - 经 BTF 验证

> ⚠️ **重要说明**：新 profile 的 task_struct 偏移是从最接近的现有 profile 复制的，应在实机使用前用设备 BTF 交叉验证。

---

## 🛠️ 技术细节

### sys_exit_tp_funcs 设计哲学

| 方面 | PR #241 (旧) | v2 (新) |
|------|--------------|----------|
| 方法 | 重定向 probestub | NULL funcs 指针 |
| 依赖 | tracepoint 结构布局 | 无结构体假设 |
| 安全性 | 需验证 probestub 地址 | 简单 NULL 写入 |
| 幂等性 | 需回读验证 | 天然幂等 |
| CONFIG_HAVE_STATIC_CALL | 需处理布局差异 | 不受影响 |
| 复杂度 | 扫描 + 匹配 + 回写 | 单次写 |

### 实现路径

```
W1 (SELinux) → vr1 (全局熔断) → W2 (凭据) → W3 (seccomp) → handoff
```

- `vr1` 在 victim spawn 之前运行，确保 step 协议严格串行
- 全局熔断覆盖 root shell 和 late-load helper，per-task clear 无法触及的范围

---

## 🧪 测试状态

- [x] **主机单元测试**：现有测试通过
- [x] **静态分析**：代码审查通过
- [x] **Profile 提取**：PD2463 / iQOO15 的 boot.img 解析完成
- [ ] **真机验证**：❌ 尚未进行（需用户在实机上运行并观察 logcat）

---

## 📋 验证命令

```bash
# 真机测试时观察
adb logcat | grep -E "VR:|vr\.ko"

# 期望输出示例
"VR.ko loaded; clearing tags"
"VR.ko sys_exit probes disabled globally"
"VR.ko per-task tags cleared"
```

---

本贡献遵循项目原有的 Apache License 2.0。

**日期**: 2026-10-03  
**设备**: PD2463 / iQOO15 (SM8750, Kernel 6.6.89 / 6.12.58)

title: src: Clearing vr tag wasnt enough; neutralize sys_exit probe too
body:
Per-task vr tag clearing (w2b) alone does not prevent vr.ko from killing the child at euid=0 — the global sys_exit tracepoint probe also needs to be disabled.
On versions 5.10, 5.15, and 6.12, this remains unresolved.

title: Add boot auto-root, notification
body:
This adds optional GhostLock runs after reboot once the user has unlocked the device. Boot settings live under the main menu: toggle auto-run, set max attempts, and a short note about unlock timing, notifications, CPU pair, and OEM autostart. There is also a read-only line for the last boot auto-run outcome (scheduled, failed, finished, skipped).

Auto-run is wired through BOOT_COMPLETED and USER_UNLOCKED, a foreground service, and the existing exploit path. We dropped the earlier “run before unlock” / Direct Boot path so prefs and filesDir stay on credential-encrypted storage after unlock.

Notifications are configurable in a separate settings screen. While a run is active, the shade shows “GhostLock running”; with step counter enabled, the body is step N of 6 parsed from exploit milestones, not log spam. Manual Run uses the same prefs but stays on a low-importance channel. Boot success shows a toast (“Root ready”) instead of a result notification; boot runs set GHOSTLOCK_BOOT_RUN so ksud late-load runs without --allow-shell, which was opening the KernelSU app on some devices.

A few stability fixes landed along the way: one exploit at a time via a file lock, not killing libghostlock when the activity closes, and not scheduling duplicate boot services in one process.

title: feat: add Nothing Phone (3a) Pro offsets; fix on-device hang (kernel_phys_load 0xa8080000, fastest-core default)
body:
# [PR #118] Add Nothing Phone (3a) Pro support — fix on-device hang/reboot on `6.1.157-android14-11-g82d681c9b06b-ab14634535`

> PR: https://github.com/YuKongA/ghostlock-app/pull/118
> Commits (this branch, based on latest upstream `main` @ `7c63bb9`):
> 1. `kernels: add Nothing Phone (3a) Pro 6.1.157 offsets with kernel_phys_load 0xa8080000`
> 2. `app: prefer the fastest-core cpu pair by default`
> 3. `kernels: document kernel_phys_load provenance for the 3a Pro entry`
> 4. `app: guard fastest-core pair against offline sibling; label mixed freqs` (review feedback)
> 5. `app: rank online cores by frequency to pick the fastest pair` (review feedback)

---

## 1. Summary

Adds support for the **Nothing Phone (3a) Pro** (model `A059P`, product
`AsteroidsPro`, build `B4.1-260810-1153`, Android 16 / SDK 36 /
SPL 2026-08-01) on kernel
`6.1.157-android14-11-g82d681c9b06b-ab14634535`.

Offsets were extracted from the official boot.img of that exact build with
`extract_rs` and cross-verified byte-for-byte against a second, independently
device-verified exploit profile for the same kernel image (§4). Two further
findings had to be fixed before the exploit would run at all on this device:

1. **The kernel is physically loaded at `0xa8080000`, not the QC default
   `0xa8000000`** in `target.h` — a 0x80000 (one KASLR step) error that made
   every W1/W2 write land 0x80000 *below* its real target, corrupting kernel
   data and hanging the APPS core (QCOM watchdog bite → reboot).
2. **CPU-pair auto-selection fell back to little cores 0/1** on this SoC
   (SM7635: cpus 0-3 @1.8 GHz little, 4-6 @2.4 GHz, 7 @2.5 GHz). On little
   cores the route race loses more often; a lost race still performs the
   write into memory the allocator has since re-used (issue #78), which
   wedges the kernel.

## 2. Changes

| File | Change |
| --- | --- |
| `src/kernels/6.1.157-android14-11-g82d681c9b06b-ab14634535/offsets.h` | **new**: `OFFSETS_ENTRY` for the build incl. `.kernel_phys_load = 0xa8080000` override; provenance comment |
| `src/kernels/offsets.h` | add the `#include` of the new entry |
| `app/src/main/kotlin/.../AndroidGhostlockRepository.kt` | `buildCpuPairs()`: prefer the pair `(fastest, fastest-1)` instead of only chunking freq clusters (which drops an odd-sized top cluster, e.g. the prime core on 1+3+4 layouts) |

### Why `kernel_phys_load = 0xa8080000`?

- The A059P firmware ships the **same kernel image** as the A059 JP build
  (`boot.img` → decompressed Image sha256 `b344ddc1...1a73`, verified on both
  firmwares).
- For that image the physical load address was derived from the firmware's
  own `xbl_config.img` FDT ("Kernel" reserved region) as **`0xa8080000`** and
  device-verified end-to-end.
- GhostLock's QC default (`0xa8000000`) is exactly 0x80000 lower; the p0
  fingerprint/oracle then resolves the slide relative to the wrong base, so
  every write targets `target - 0x80000`.

The register step prints a generic "MediaTek default mismatch" warning for
any non-default phys; the emitted entry is still correct and carries the
explicit override (same mechanism as the existing `6.12.38-...-4k` entry).

## 3. Reproduction (before the fix)

Device: Nothing Phone (3a) Pro, stock `B4.1-260810-1153`, locked bootloader,
no root. App/CLI run with the freshly registered offsets but **without** the
two fixes:

- phys base `0xa8000000` (no override): W1 SELinux race hangs the kernel on
  the first TCP-route attempt; `qcom,gh-watchdog: Causing a QCOM Apps
  Watchdog bite` in pstore after ~90 s → reboot. Forcing
  `GHOSTLOCK_TCP_ROUTE=0` (pselect route) hangs even faster.
- phys base fixed but default cpu pair 0/1: W1 completes, W2 wedges around
  attempt 3.

With **both** fixes (`kernel_phys_load=0xa8080000` + cores 6/7):

```
W1: SELinux attempt 2/15 → Write 1 complete          (+3.9 s)
W2: attempt 1 miss → attempt 2 → "child uid = 0"     (+9.2 s)
[+] child is root!
[*] exploit complete                                   (+15.4 s)
```

No hang during the exploit; on the validation baseline the full flow also
completed with the KernelSU module late-loaded and SELinux restored to
enforcing, with the device stable afterwards.

## 4. Verification evidence

- **Offsets**: `extract_rs` output for the A059P boot.img equals, symbol for
  symbol, the Root-My-Device `target-core61.h` profile for the same kernel
  (independently derived and device-verified on A059 JP `B4.1-260618-1048`,
  whose boot.img decompresses to the identical Image sha256).
- **phys base**: `0xa8080000` from that profile's xbl-derived
  `P0_KERNEL_PHYS_LOAD`; DRAM memstart `0x80000000` re-confirmed in the A059P
  firmware's own `vendor_boot.img`/`dtbo.img`.
- **On-device**: CLI runs (`adb shell`, no seccomp → W3 skipped); SELinux
  flipped to permissive (W1 verify), child reached `uid 0` (W2 verify);
  full-success runs on the validation baseline incl. module late-load and
  `enforce=1` restore.

## 5. Residual risk (known, upstream issue #78)

A lost route race can still perform its write into reallocated memory; on
this device such a miss occasionally wedges the kernel instead of failing
cleanly. Same failure class as issue #78 — not introduced by this PR.
Recommendation: run on a fresh boot, save work first, reboot between
attempts.

## 6. Validation baseline & note for maintainers (upstream #115)

On-device validation was performed on upstream `8f8a8bb` (pre-#115). After
rebasing the same two commits onto current `main` (`35b9854`, which includes
#115 "fix kernelsnitch leak and collision handling"), behavior on this
**non-MTE** 6.1 kernel degraded. A/B over fresh-boot runs:

| Baseline (same offsets/phys/cores) | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `8f8a8bb` (pre-#115) | **2/2 full success** (W2 lands ~attempt 2, device stable) |
| `35b9854` (post-#115) | **0/4 clean success** (2× hang during W1 → watchdog reboot, 1× W2 15 rounds all miss, 1× W2 incomplete) |

Suspected cause: #115 removed the `mte_enabled` flag and now unconditionally
sweeps all 16 tag nibbles in `kernelsnitch.h __mm_leak()` (plus `| 0xf <<
56` on leaked pointers in `util.c`/`main.c`), which perturbs leak/collision
behavior on kernels without MTE.

The changes in this PR (offsets entry, default CPU pair) are **orthogonal to
#115** and correct on both baselines. Flagging the #115 observation here for
maintainers (no separate issue filed): if the unconditional tag sweep is not
intended for non-MTE devices, making it conditional on MTE detection again
would likely restore the pre-#115 behavior on this kernel family. Happy to
re-test on-device after any change.

## 7. How to verify on your side

```bash
# offsets (already committed here)
tools/extract_rs/target/release/ghostlock-extract.exe boot.img \
  --phys 0xa8080000 --force --register          # boot.img of B4.1-260810-1153

# CLI smoke test on the device (shell context, W3 skipped):
adb push ghostlock /data/local/tmp/ghostlock
adb shell chmod 755 /data/local/tmp/ghostlock
adb shell "cd /data/local/tmp && GHOSTLOCK_CORE=6 GHOSTLOCK_CONSUMER_CORE=7 \
  ./ghostlock"
# expect: W1 → Write 1 complete; W2 → "child uid = 0"; "child is root!"
```

Expected device identity (`getprop`): `ro.product.model=A059P`,
`ro.product.device=Asteroids`, `ro.product.product=AsteroidsPro`,
`ro.build.display.id=B4.1-260810-1153`, `uname -r=6.1.157-android14-11-g82d681c9b06b-ab14634535`.
